01. Which statement below best describes the highest level of education you have completed? Options: High school graduate, diploma or the equivalent (GED) | Some College | Associate Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree

02. This position REQUIRES a minimum of 6 ECE or CD units from an accredited college/university. Do you meet these minimum requirements? If yes is selected, you must include a copy of your transcripts with your application. Options: Yes | No
Maintain District standards of excellent customer service and professional behavior in various and sometimes challenging situations.
Access and monitor District email daily to receive important updates from school and District administration.
Participate in staff development and in-service training programs as assigned.
Direct students through a variety of experiences to enhance the students’ ability to begin school ready to learn in all curricular areas.

Assist in planning for and providing individualized daily programs of activities appropriate to the developmental level of the children in the areas of language acquisition and social and self-help skills.
Assist in conducting individual parent conferences about students’ growth and development.
Observe and control behavior of students according to approved procedures, reports progress regarding student performance and behavior to the classroom teacher.
Perform a variety of clerical duties such as preparing, typing and duplicating instructional materials,

Provide support to the teacher by preparing for daily activities, setting up work areas, displays and exhibits, and distributing and collecting paper, supplies and materials; assist with gathering materials for projects and preparing handouts, folders and classroom worksheets.
Assure the health and safety of students by following health and safety practices and procedures.
Assist in rendering various forms of personal care such as toileting, diapering, dressing, undressing, bathing, and grooming.
Assist in planning and conducting a daily program of integrated curricular and learning experiences to children in a comfortable, and safe atmosphere.
Communicates effectively and professionally and collaborates with educational partners.
Attend parent education meetings, workshops, and program training as needed.
Provide work direction to volunteers as assigned.
Participate in staff development and in-service training programs as assigned.
